title: CROSS-MORSE: Cross-Spectral Control of Message Passing in Frozen Graph Neural Networks (reference implementation)
description: CROSS-MORSE reference implementation for inference-time control of frozen graph neural networks. Includes seven dataset adapters, 21 configurations, experiment and Slurm drivers, tests, environment specifications, two complete synthetic examples, and artifact-based result builders. Archive locations, identities and reconstruction coverage are recorded in the release manifests and AVAILABILITY.md. Companion manuscript under review.
